cycles.scope: Two old records across two rules and three controls; coefficient, clamp, clone, state and clock checks.
Four fixed records across the six lives; pre-outcome timing/cache, arrived-byte label, clamp, state-isolation and scoring-label adversarial checks.
One complete paired world plus exactly one fresh-process replay; full receipt semantics, shared trajectories and clocks, fixed sixteen-contrast analysis with synthetic inputs.

audit_basis: The accepted independent cycle reports and their preserved scientific receipts. This publication preparation rechecked bytes and public pilot/replay equality; it did not rerun scientific qualification or generate native outcomes.
limitations: Full native state arrays and every intermediate address are not present in compact receipts; source assertions and operative state hashes support these invariants.
Student-t simultaneous coverage is approximate. The zero-variance Hoeffding fallback can make the noninferiority gate inconclusive.
No qualification outcome was used to select a sample extension or scientific parameter change.
